itemized.notes: 2006 handwritten form, scanned COPY (the word 'COPY' is stamped on the cover). Cover: AARON D. KENNARD, Republican, Office Sought SHERIFF, District Number 'County Wide'; INTERIM / April 5 box checked ('For the period ending March 31, 2006'); signed 4-5-06; clerk stamp RECEIVED APR 05 2006 - agrees with the chunk listing. NOTHING IN THIS DOCUMENT IS REDACTED - the candidate's own address is printed on the cover and donor/vendor street addresses are written on the schedules. That makes the privacy rule the binding constraint rather than a redaction bar: every street address encountered was discarded at read time and appears in no field or note. EVERY DATE ON EVERY SCHEDULE ROW IS MONTH/YEAR ONLY ('3/06', '2/06', '1/06') with no day-of-month, so all 28 rows carry a BLANK date and needs_review=1 - the year is not in doubt but a day-of-month was never written, and the brief forbids inventing one. One expenditure row (AOL) carries THREE stacked month/year tokens in the single date cell. All amounts on this filing are whole dollars with no cents anywhere. Schedule A has only two contributors totalling $520 against $5,440 of spending - the campaign was drawing down a $61,337 opening balance.
